summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-10-28 ~ 2026-10-29）

- 🔧 sysctl 用类型化指针替换重载的 extra 指针，覆盖 arm64/x86 多个调用点（[Scheduling](#subsystem-Scheduling)）
- ✨ 统一 gcov/kcov 覆盖率框架并接入 Clang source-based coverage，跨架构共用同一套插桩（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- 🔥 btrfs 与 VFS 新增 ptime 来源时间，贯通 stat/fileattr 与 tree-log，扩展 UAPI（[Filesystem & Storage](#subsystem-Filesystem%20%26%20Storage)）
- ⚡ f2fs 可写大 folio 支持贯通压缩、GC、目录与节点路径，减少拆分与元数据开销（[Filesystem & Storage](#subsystem-Filesystem%20%26%20Storage)）
- ⚡ 内存分配水位检查不再忽略 ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT，避免碎片化分配绕过水位限制（[Memory](#subsystem-Memory)）
- ✨ kTLS 支持 TLS 1.3 KeyUpdate，连接内即可轮换密钥，省去重新握手开销（[Networking](#subsystem-Networking)）

## Scheduling
- `perf` `other` ：重构 sysctl 类型化指针，替换重载 extra 指针，覆盖 arm64/x86 等多架构调用点，降低维护歧义。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/29/3)
- 新增 Kernel Assurance Plane 安全机制，提供 securityfs/ABI 并接入 fork/nsproxy，用于内核完整性保障。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1354)
- sched/fair 用 Bresenham 算法替代随机选择 newidle_balance 的 CPU，使空闲负载均衡更确定、可复现。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/317)
- sched_ext 避免不必要的 IMMED 调度操作，减少该路径的调度开销与延迟。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1930)
- `other` ：发布 7.3.1-rc1 审查补丁集，覆盖 io_uring、sched、key 等改动，供稳定分支回归验证。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1961)
- `other` ：发布 7.2.14-rc1 审查补丁集，覆盖 io_uring、sched、ntfs 等改动，供稳定分支回归验证。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1964)
- `bugfix` ：修复 uclamp 与非原子 static key 启用之间的竞态，避免并发场景下 uclamp 状态不一致。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/161)

## Architecture
- `perf` remoteproc v7.4 更新：新增多平台 PAS/SCP 绑定，核心与 qcom/imx 驱动重构 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1549)
- `perf` 统一 gcov/kcov 覆盖率框架并加入 Clang source-based coverage，跨架构共用同一套插桩 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1118)
- `perf` camss 增加 SM8750 支持，新增 CSID 980、VFE gen4 与视频节点路径 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/766)
- dmaengine v7.4 更新：多份 DMA 绑定转 YAML，补充新平台描述并清理驱动 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1672)
- `perf` arm64 dts 增加小米 Poco M3（citrus）支持，补齐 sm6115 板级描述 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/45)
- `perf` x86/entry/32 强化返回用户态路径，收紧入口检查，提升内核安全边界 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/51)
- camss 增加 Kaanapali 支持，新增 CSID 1080、VFE 1080 与 TPG 模块 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1682)
- arm64 dts 增加 MSM8952 与 General Mobile Shamrock 初始支持 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1014)
- `other` KVM 各架构统一 WAIT 请求语义，确保发起等待的 vCPU 真正进入等待而非直接返回 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2142)
- KVM arm64 vgic-v4 不再为已销毁 VM 分配 vPE，避免残留 vPE 占用 ITS 资源 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/891)
- 另有 36 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1188) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/970) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/265) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1078) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1623) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1483) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1291) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1716) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1173) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/390) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/353) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/410) 等 36 项

## Drivers
- `perf` platform-drivers-x86 v7.4-1 合入：新增多款笔记本平台驱动并清理 ABI 文档，同时调整 ACPI 视频检测逻辑 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/851)
- I3C 7.4 更新：core/hub/device 框架调整，新增 NXP P3H2840 绑定并改进多个 master 驱动 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/887)
- DW SPI 控制器新增 DDR 双速率传输支持，配套 spi-nor Macronix 读路径改造 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1157)
- drm tiny 新增 Valkyrie USB LCD 驱动，复用 drm_format_helper 做像素格式转换 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/29/59)
- Valkyrie USB LCD 早期版本，附带 HID quirk 避免同类接口抢占绑定 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1317)
- drm/dp 从扩展 DPCD 能力中保留基础增强成帧位，修正链路能力判断 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1899)
- `bugfix` gpio core 用 dummy 设备替换 shared 线路的平台查找，简化依赖并修正引用计数 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1564)
- `other` ALSA memalloc 在 WC DMA 映射失败时释放新分配页，避免内存泄漏 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1562)
- `bugfix` gpio shared-proxy 修正线路计数错误，避免代理线路重复记账 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1215)
- `perf` ACPI 处理器热控：限值撤销时不再残留旧值，避免降频后性能长期被压制 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2052)
- 另有 45 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1242) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1336) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1446) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/179) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1588) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1015) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/664) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/487) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/916) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/802) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/576) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/79) 等 45 项

## Virtualization
- `perf` KVM TDX 增加对可直接配置 CPUID 位的合法性校验，防止透传宿主不支持的位给 guest。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/595)
- `other` 将 KVM x86 各处运行时 WARN 统一改为 WARN_ONCE，避免同一问题反复刷日志、降低触发开销。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2124)
- `other` nSVM 在合成的 NMI 退出信息中填入 NMI_VECTOR，使 guest 读到正确的退出向量字段。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1329)
- 为 virtio/vhost vsock 增加数据报传输支持，同步扩展 uapi 与传输层，补齐 SOCK_DGRAM 能力。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1844)
- vfio-pci zPCI 改进 Function Measurement 上报，扩展 uapi 以向用户态暴露更多 zPCI 性能计数信息。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1807)
- `other` coalesced_mmio 拒绝无法放入 int 的 zone 大小，避免后续地址与尺寸计算溢出。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/158)
- `bugfix` vmgenid 在使用 ACPI companion 前先判空，避免缺少 ACPI 描述时解引用空指针。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/431)

## Observability
- `perf` 合入 7.4 文档更新，涵盖内核参数与 core-api 说明并同步葡语翻译，便于运维与开发查阅 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1693)
- `perf` `bugfix` 重写 event filter 解析，修正语法与匹配逻辑，并补充 filter 及 error log 自测用例 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/93)
- `perf` 新增 Alpha ProfileMe 采样解码，补充 arch 头与 sample-raw 解析，扩展工具跨架构分析能力 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2076)
- `perf` cpufreq 自测在触发事件后停止 CPU 热插拔循环，避免测试挂起与残留状态 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/870)
- `perf` `other` BPF stackmap 读取 perf callchain 时始终持有 RCU 读锁，避免回调期间链数据失效 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1167)
- `perf` `bugfix` 修正 cs-etm 中 should't 拼写错误，纯文字修正 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2109)
- rpmsg 更新驱动与 uapi，并同步示例和文档，调整 virtio 与 MediaTek 通道行为 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1521)
- `perf` sparc 7.4 更新整理页表、highmem、线程信息等头文件与 Kconfig，精简 32/64 位公共代码 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1382)
- 更新 Sphinx 依赖检查脚本，按新版要求校验文档构建依赖，减少环境误报 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/36)
- `bugfix` kgdb 更新调试核心、gdbstub 与 kdb 输入输出，提升断点与串口调试稳定性 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1963)
- 另有 7 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/274) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/555) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/863) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/258) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/736) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1687) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2136)

## Filesystem & Storage
- UFS core 为 BIWIN 设备清除上电 UNIT ATTENTION，新增厂商 quirk 以正常识别 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1266)
- `perf` f2fs 可写大 folio 支持贯通压缩、GC、目录与节点路径，降低拆分与元数据开销 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1779)
- ntfs3 7.4 更新覆盖索引、日志、目录、属性与挂载路径，扩展文件系统能力 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/538)
- btrfs 与 VFS 新增 ptime 来源时间，贯通 stat/fileattr、inode 与 tree-log，扩展 UAPI [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1390)
- `other` 在注册用户态接口前初始化设备状态，覆盖 aoe、fsl-mc、mshv、ibmvmc、dcssblk 等 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/377)
- ksmbd 增加用户/组到 Windows SID 的映射与 idmap 配置，提升 SMB ACL 互操作 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/478)
- btrfs 在 extent-tree/free-space-cache 中拦截 ERESTARTSYS，避免 ioctl 向用户态返回内部重启码 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2103)
- btrfs FITRIM 不再泄漏 -ERESTARTSYS，trim ioctl 返回更符合用户态预期 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/500)
- fs/libfs 仅在声明后补空行，属代码风格清理，不改变运行行为 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/280)
- btrfs 在事务启动前设置块大小，保证卷设备参数在后续事务中生效 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1165)
- 另有 28 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/494) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1751) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/794) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/748) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1460) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1700) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/411) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/207) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/756) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2104) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1790) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/469) 等 28 项

## Clocks & Timers
- 为 clk 框架新增 provider 休眠恢复机制，使时钟提供者在系统休眠（hibe）后能够恢复自身时钟状态。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/829)
- TI DPLL 改用通用展频（spread spectrum）实现，统一了时钟描述与驱动代码。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/549)
- 新增 STM32MP25 LTDC 像素时钟源选择，借助 syscfg 驱动与板级 overlay 配置显示时钟。[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1428)
- 另有 3 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1804) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1227) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/773)

## Memory
- `perf` `other` 水位检查不再忽略 ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT，避免碎片化分配绕过水位限制，改善内存碎片与回收行为 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1323)
- `perf` `other` 细化 NUMA 内存分层迁移启发式，结合调度侧统计减少无效跨层迁移，提升热页放置准确度 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/348)
- `perf` `other` DAMON 迁移时跳过已在目标节点的 folio，省去无谓页迁移开销 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/29/1)
- 简化 sparse vmemmap 对齐检查逻辑，减少冗余运算，便于后续维护与扩展 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1161)
- `bugfix` hugetlb 修正 CMA 预留与 surplus 分配路径的页计数和分配失败处理 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1067)
- `bugfix` zswap 修复写回路径中 LRU 节点计数被重复递减的问题 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1073)
- `bugfix` memory-failure 先更新统计再输出日志，避免日志中出现过期计数 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/589)
- `bugfix` damon/sysfs 修正错误处理路径导致的 pid 泄漏（6.12.y 稳定版）[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1451)
- `bugfix` damon/sysfs 修正错误处理路径导致的 pid 泄漏（6.6.y 稳定版）[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1459)
- `bugfix` damon/sysfs 修正错误处理路径导致的 pid 泄漏（6.1.y 稳定版）[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1467)
- 另有 10 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/842) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2001) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/113) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1340) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2116) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1775) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/438) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1387) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/711) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/333)

## Networking
- `perf` `other` kTLS 增加 TLS 1.3 KeyUpdate 处理，连接内即可轮换密钥省去重握手开销，附带文档与自测 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1420)
- `perf` `other` 内层隧道无加密卸载时改用软件 GSO 发送，减少分片与重组开销 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1476)
- IOAM 插入对 IPv6 ECMP 透明，路由哈希不再因插入而改变，避免路径抖动 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/443)
- 禁止 KCM 与 TLS 套接字组合，避免走入不受支持的收发路径 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2014)
- 无 net_admin 权限时隐藏 MPTCP 序列号计数器，减少诊断信息暴露 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/640)
- IPv6 网关有效性检查不再受链路状态影响，link down 时不再误判路由失效 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1734)
- 修正 bridge CFM 连续性检查接收监控的状态转换，超时与计数判断更准确 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/29/44)
- `other` inet_diag 的 get_info 回调增加 net_admin 权限参数，为各协议按权限裁剪诊断字段铺路 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/630)
- `other` espintcp 封装时清除外层 TCP GSO 元数据，避免错误分段 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/59)
- `other` OCB 模式强制站点数量上限，防止对等体超额分配 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1505)
- 另有 56 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1532) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1608) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/497) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1275) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1375) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/2131) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1837) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1064) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/237) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/212) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1606) [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1520) 等 56 项

## Core Kernel
- `perf` 引入 `__nonnull_args` 宏统一标注非空参数，替换各处零散 `__nonnull` 用法，减少头文件重复声明与编译告警噪音 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/609)
- `perf` `other` lib/crypto AES 表清理改用 `memzero_explicit`，防止编译器把敏感数据清零优化掉，运行开销不变 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1519)
- `other` ipc/sem 对放大后的 sops 数组计入内存核算并校验参数，避免 semop 数组无序膨胀 [↗](https://lkml.org/lkml/2026/10/28/1958)
